from sympy import sqrt, I
from sympy.simplify.sqrtdenest import sqrtdenest
# The exact input given in the issue. It simplifies to I in SymPy since (3+3I - sqrt(2)*sqrt(4+3I))/2 equals I
print(sqrtdenest((3 - sqrt(2)*sqrt(4 + 3*I) + 3*I)/2))
# Additional edge cases
print(sqrtdenest(sqrt(5 + 2*sqrt(6))))
print(sqrtdenest(sqrt(3 + 2*sqrt(3))))
print(sqrtdenest(3/2 - sqrt(2)*sqrt(4 + 3*I)/2 + 3*I/2))
